standard.title: Irregular -IR Verbs (sortir, partir, dormir, sentir)
standard.explanation: Some -IR verbs are irregular. They drop the last three letters of the infinitive stem for singular forms (je, tu, il/elle/on) but keep them for plural forms (nous, vous, ils/elles). The verbs sortir (to go out), partir (to leave), dormir (to sleep), and sentir (to feel) all follow this pattern.

drills.question: Je ___ à la boîte vendredi.
drills.explanation: Je sors — for 'I', use the singular stem 'sor-' without the final -t.

drills.question: Nous ___ à neuf heures.
drills.explanation: Nous sortons — for 'we', keep the full stem 'sort-' + -ons.

advanced.title: Irregular -IR Verbs — sortir, partir, dormir, sentir + Full Patterns
advanced.explanation: Irregular -IR verbs (sortir, partir, dormir, sentir) drop the final three letters of the infinitive stem in singular forms (je, tu, il/elle/on) but retain them in plural forms (nous, vous, ils/elles). This creates a contrast: je sors vs nous sortons. Understanding this pattern helps conjugate all four verbs correctly and recognizes that other -IR verbs may have different irregular patterns. Compounds like ressentir (to feel/experience) and repartir (to leave again) follow the same pattern.

standard.scenario: Invite a friend out and agree on a plan for Saturday night.
standard.modelAnswer: Tu veux sortir samedi soir? On peut aller à la boîte ou au bar. Je préfère la boîte pour danser. À neuf heures, ça va?
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: This response invites the friend, gives two options, expresses a preference, and suggests a time.
standard.tip: Use 'Tu veux...' for invitations and 'On peut...' to suggest alternatives. Always include a time.

advanced.scenario: Invite a friend out and agree on a plan for Saturday night, including details about what you'll do.
advanced.modelAnswer: Tu veux sortir samedi soir avec moi? On pourrait aller à la boîte ou au pub. Je préfère la boîte parce que j'aime danser. On y va vers neuf heures? Ça te convient?
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: This response includes an invitation with context, gives alternatives with reasoning, and confirms the time with the other person.
advanced.tip: Use 'Tu veux...' and 'On pourrait...' for more flexible invitations. Provide reasons for your preferences and confirm plans with 'Ça te convient?'
